_rule: Prepared before any run. Git metadata read-only: uncommitted, no live quality pass.

shot-on.source: Post-water water-compose float mean / exposure. Cnew = Cold + A Lhit - Bprobe only on fully qualified tier 2/3 hits. Unsupported hits unchanged. ON mean must equal OFF within OFF repeat noise; no gain correction. Unknown hit radiance prevents a numerical prediction offline.
shot-on.cost_source: Measure reflections GPU and compose GPU medians vs OFF. Full-frame rf shade 2.3-2.7 ms is context, not a water estimate.
shot-on.coverage: Native shaded hidden > 0 in every ON cost window. Off-screen may stay zero: native_hit_cluster rejects outside the frustum. Unsupported rows/light sources retain probes.
shot-on.visual: Static and matched forward turns: reflected hidden geometry appears while native lighting supports the hit. Full outside-frustum shading requires later world-light provider.
